description: This file contains unit tests for activation repartitioning in Orleans, specifically testing a frequency filtering component, including sampling from a Zipf distribution, and a test class for frequency filtering behavior.

classes.name: FrequencyFilterTests
classes.description: Contains a unit test method for verifying top-K frequency filtering.

classes.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A specialized collection for maintaining frequent ulong items with add/remove capabilities, based on FrequentItemCollection.

classes.name: FastZipf
classes.description: Provides static methods for generating Zipf-distributed samples efficiently.

classes.name: ZipfRejectionSampler
classes.description: Implements rejection sampling for Zipf distribution.

classes.name: TestKey
classes.description: A structure representing a key with an internal counter and string representation.

methods.name: GetExpectedTopK
methods.description: Unit test for verifying frequencies and top-k elements generated via Zipf sampling.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Static method returning the next sequential TestKey.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific TestKey element from the frequency collection.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates an array of Zipf-distributed samples using rejection sampling.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Samples a value from the Zipf distribution using rejection sampling.

methods.name: bInvCdf
methods.description: Computes the inverse CDF for the Zipf distribution in the sampler.
